items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And in the reed section they had Charlie Parker playing the lead... Lucky Thompson was playing tenor... And a little later on... they added Lucky Thompson. So we hooked up again.

ctx.x: That group really kind of stayed together. Because when I started going to dances just a few years later, in 1949, you were there every Sunday, no matter where the session was...

Well, we were like the session group. And when Dexter was on, Dexter was here. And Lucky Thompson, the fine tenor saxophone player, he had migrated to California with Boyd Raeburn's big band, and they played at the Radio Room up on Vine, between Selma and Hollywood Boulevard.
